data.desc: Inuvo, Inc. (NYSE American: INUV) provides artificial intelligence-driven solutions for modeling media audiences. IntentKey AI, built on our issued patents, analyzes real-time media consumption to identify why prospects are interested in a product or brand, often identifying emerging audience shifts up to 24 hours before they become competitive in the open market. Inuvo's AI does not rely on consumer IDs, supporting a privacy-by-design approach to advertising.
